title: 第3章 生活不易陈昭叹气第4章 师兄我太想进步了
slug: 道爷斗法累了西幻炸个鱼怎么了
lines: 在穿越之初，陈昭也幻想过自己会是网文中的主角，原地杵着都是王霸之气侧漏，抬手一挥就是小弟成群，各路女修闭眼倒贴，抢着喊“哥哥和我一起组道侣吧”
曾几何时陈昭也曾各种呐喊，诸如
系统！
统子！
统子哥？统子哥你在吗！
签到？我要签到！
模拟器呢？有没有模拟器？
金手指！
大哥来个金手指也行啊！
风灵月影启动！
启动！
你给我启动啊！
除了因为半夜扰民被打了一顿以外没有任何收获。
在众多的磨难后，陈昭明白了一件事，修仙一道没有捷径，自己没有通天大修的背景就只能老老实实的从最基础练起。
随着灵气大药吞入腹中，瞬间分解成斑驳着杂质的灵气聚团，陈昭运作起功法来，这门功法并非天门宗统一赐给杂役弟子的天门功，而是来自陈昭先前加入的那个，已经被天门宗摧毁的门派，名为锻灵法。
虽然因为宗门被灭，只有炼气期的残本，可对于现在的陈昭来说，有的练总比没得练好。
催动起体内的灵气不断循环冲刷这聚团，陈昭将分割出来的灵气泵入体内经脉之中循环起来。
以陈昭现在的功法和灵根，外来的灵气需要经过四十九个小周天七个大周天的一次循环才能炼化为自身灵气，在补充先前消耗的灵气之时，这循环的效率还是很快的。
但当原本的灵气份额填满，更多的灵气开始灌注之时，循环的效率便一下子跌了下来，往往要十来次循环才能略微提高一些灵气总量。
这便是杂灵根的劣势啊。
练气期提高修为的方法很简单，就好像吹气球一样，对储存灵气的虚海施加压力就能扩充，与吹气球不同的在于扩张虚海之后还要花时间去巩固，否则就会像漏气的气球一样缩小。
可这听起来简单的加压对于杂灵根来说可是困难重重，如果说单灵根就是畅通无阻的高速公路，给多少灵气基本就通过多少，极少出现堵塞，那灵气压力的提升自然轻松。
而陈昭的杂灵根就好像上下班高峰期的市区道路，同等的灵气输入十之有九点九都堵在路上，再怎么催促只能有少许部分缓缓通过，自然压力不足，需要多次吸纳才有足够的压强扩充。
约莫经过一周时间，陈昭才完全炼化了这支吞服下的灵药，境界也成功突破到了炼气后期。
陈昭长舒一口气。
练气期的修士还是需要补充摄入食物，所幸这旅馆有食物供给，陈昭便一口气购入了大量的菜肴，放在戒指之中。
空间系的储物法宝，越是强大，其间时间流逝的速度便越是缓慢，经过测试，戒指内时间流逝速度要远低于陈昭的两个储物袋，既然此时戒指是陈昭使用，那么自然是将物品储存在其中。
除了吃饭和解决卫生问题，陈昭是不眠不休的炼化这枚灵药，即便是累极了也是打坐冥想片刻，这样也消耗了一周的时间。
也难怪有许多气修天赋一般的修士们弃而转向炼体，通过熬打自身肉体来求得长生。
这杂灵根真不是人练的啊。
看来得尽早更换灵根了。
陈昭摸了摸胸口。
不知为何，这弑心蛊虫没什么动静，即便陈昭使用神识内窥，也没见那弑心蛊虫有任何不对劲的地方。
这弑心蛊虫会听从主人的安排，定时行动，记得当时常乐道人给的时间期限是十五天，可明明时间已经过半，却没有动静。
要知道先前几次行动的时候，一旦时限过半，这弑心蛊便会轻咬心脏提醒，使人又痒又疼。
也许是秘境的效果，也是好事，这弑心蛊就是悬在陈昭头上的一把利刃，是小命掌握在他人手中的不适。
不过陈昭也不敢赌这期限一到，这弑心蛊就一定不会行动，还是要尽快寻找到离开这秘境的办法。
希望那筑基长老已经不在原地等待了吧。
以防万一，陈昭还是决定先耗费一些时间打磨自己的战力。
如今进阶到了炼气后期，能运用的手段便多了些许。
content_en:
At the beginning of the time travel, Chen Zhao also imagined that he would be the protagonist in the online novel. He stood there with his domineering energy leaking out, and with a wave of his hand, there were a group of younger brothers. Female cultivators from all walks of life closed their eyes and fell to each other, shouting "Brother, let's form a Taoist couple with me."
Once upon a time, Chen Zhao also shouted in various ways, such as
System!
Tongzi!
Brother Tongzi? Brother Tongzi, are you there?
Sign in? I want to sign in!
What about the simulator? Is there any emulator?
Goldfinger!
Brother, it’s okay to have a golden finger!
Wind Spirit Moon Shadow is activated!
start up!
Start it for me!
There was nothing gained except being beaten for disturbing others in the middle of the night.
After many hardships, Chen Zhao understood one thing. There is no shortcut to cultivating immortality. Since he did not have a background in Tongtian Daxiu, he could only practice from the very basics honestly.
As the spiritual energy potion was swallowed into his belly, it instantly decomposed into a group of spiritual energy mottled with impurities. Chen Zhao started to operate the technique. This technique was not the Tianmen Technique given to the handyman disciples by the Tianmen Sect, but came from the sect that Chen Zhao had previously joined and had been destroyed by the Tianmen Sect, called Spirit Forging Technique.
Although because the sect was destroyed, there are only remnants of the Qi Refining Period, but for Chen Zhao now, some practice is better than no practice at all.
Motivating the spiritual energy in his body to continuously wash away the mass, Chen Zhao pumped the separated spiritual energy into the meridians in his body for circulation.
With Chen Zhao's current skills and spiritual roots, the external spiritual energy needs to go through a cycle of forty-nine small heavens and seven large heavens before it can be refined into his own spiritual energy. When replenishing the previously consumed spiritual energy, the efficiency of this cycle is still very fast.
But when the original share of spiritual energy is filled and more spiritual energy begins to be poured in, the efficiency of the cycle suddenly drops, and it often takes more than ten cycles to slightly increase the total amount of spiritual energy.
This is the disadvantage of mixed spirit roots.
The method to improve your cultivation during the Qi training period is very simple. Just like blowing up a balloon, applying pressure to the virtual sea that stores spiritual energy will expand. The difference from blowing up a balloon is that after expanding the virtual sea, you have to spend time to consolidate it, otherwise it will shrink like a deflated balloon.
But this sounds like simple pressurization, but it is very difficult for miscellaneous spiritual roots. If a single spiritual root is like a smooth highway, as much spiritual energy as you give it will basically pass through, and there are very few blockages, then the increase in spiritual energy pressure will naturally be easy.
Chen Zhao's miscellaneous spiritual roots are like urban roads during rush hour. Nine out of ten of the same spiritual energy inputs will be blocked on the road. No matter how much you urge, only a small part can pass slowly. The natural pressure is insufficient, and it needs to be absorbed multiple times to have enough pressure expansion.
After about a week, Chen Zhao completely refined the swallowed elixir, and his realm successfully reached the late stage of Qi refining.
Chen Zhao let out a long sigh of relief.
The monks in the Qi training period still need to supplement their food intake. Fortunately, the hotel has food supplies, so Chen Zhao bought a large number of dishes in one go and put them in the ring.
The more powerful the storage magic weapon of the space system is, the slower the passage of time will be. After testing, the speed of time passing in the ring is much slower than that of Chen Zhao's two storage bags. Since the ring is used by Chen Zhao at this time, it is natural to store items in it.
In addition to eating and solving hygiene problems, Chen Zhao worked tirelessly to refine this elixir. Even when he was extremely tired, he would sit and meditate for a while, which also consumed a week.
It’s no wonder that many monks with average talent in Qi cultivation give up and turn to body training, seeking immortality by beating their bodies.
This miscellaneous spiritual root is really not practiced by humans.
It seems that the spiritual root must be replaced as soon as possible.
Chen Zhao touched his chest.
For some reason, there was no movement from the Heart-Killing Gu Insect. Even if Chen Zhao used his spiritual sense to see inside, he could not see anything wrong with the Heart-Killing Gu Insect.
This heart-killing Gu insect will obey the master's arrangements and act on time. I remember that the time limit given by Taoist Chang Le was fifteen days, but it was already half way through, but there was no movement.
You must know that during the previous actions, once the time limit passed halfway, the heart-killing poison would bite the heart to remind you, causing itching and pain.
Maybe it's the effect of the secret realm, but it's also a good thing. This heart-killing Gu is a sharp blade hanging over Chen Zhao's head, and it's the discomfort of having his life in the hands of others.
However, Chen Zhao did not dare to bet that the heart-killing Gu would not act once the deadline was up. He still had to find a way to leave this secret realm as soon as possible.
I hope the foundation-building elder is no longer waiting where he is.
Just in case, Chen Zhao decided to spend some time polishing his combat power first.
Now that he has advanced to the later stage of Qi Refining, he has a few more methods that he can use.
title_en: Chapter 3: Life is not easy. Chen Zhao sighed. Chapter 4: Senior brother, I really want to make progress.
